notes:
Net map. The drawing is upright and clean: one series loop with two parallel pairs in it. 0 = ground node - the bottom edge of the left box (the horizontal at y~268 running x 87..168), the vertical dropping from it at x=105 down to GND 7 (bars at y=325 and y=331), and the horizontal at y~313 running right from that junction to the left end of I-DC 0. Holds GND 7, the lower plate of capacitor 3, the lower plate of capacitor 4 and the left terminal of I-DC 0. n1 = the top edge of the left box (horizontal at y=187 running x 84..171) plus the stub at x=131 that rises from it to y~172: upper plate of capacitor 3, upper plate of capacitor 4, left lead of resistor 6 (50 ohm). n2 = the wire from the right lead of resistor 6 along y~180 to x=335, down the stub at x=333 to the top edge of the right box (horizontal at y=202 running x 296..371): right lead of resistor 6, upper lead of inductor 2 (15 mH), upper lead of inductor 1 (30 uH). n3 = the bottom edge of the right box (horizontal at y=283 running x 296..365), the stub at x=341 dropping from it to y~316, and the wire left along y~316 to the right lead of resistor 5 (30 ohm): lower lead of inductor 2, lower lead of inductor 1, right lead of resistor 5. n4 = the short wire between the right terminal of I-DC 0 and the left lead of resistor 5. So: 7 A source -> 30 ohm -> (15 mH || 30 uH) -> 50 ohm -> (50 uF || 20 mF) -> back to ground.
Judgment calls: (a) capacitors 3 and 4 are drawn as VERTICAL two-terminal parts (their bboxes are wider than tall only because the plates are horizontal strokes); capacitor 3 sits in the left side of the left box with plates at y=214 and y=223, capacitor 4 in the right side with plates at y=223 and y=232. They are therefore in parallel between n1 and 0, not in series along the top edge. Verified on a 3-px map of x 75-200 / y 175-280.
(b) Same for the right box: inductors 2 and 1 sit in its left (x~296) and right (x~371) sides, so they are in parallel between n2 and n3.
(c) All four box corners and the three T-junctions (x=131 into the top edge, x=105 into the bottom edge, x=341 into the right box's bottom edge) are drawn as solid corners/tees with continuous ink - no dots and no hops anywhere in this drawing, and no two wires cross at all.
(d) The GND symbol hangs below the y~313 rail on the x=105 stub; the rail continues right from that same point to I-DC 0, so the whole rail is net 0.
(e) No component is off-frame: every one of the eight symbols is fully drawn inside the crop.
(f) The long near-horizontal diagonal at the top right ((240,135)->(505,150)), the one at the bottom left ((0,357)->(265,370)) and the short vertical at the far left (x~5-15, y 140-350) touch no component or lead (nearest circuit ink is 25+ px away); they are neighbouring drawings/page rules clipped in by the crop and get no net.
(g) Terminal order: I-DC 0, resistor 5 and resistor 6 are horizontal and listed left-then-right (I-DC 0's arrow points right, so its left terminal is the one on the ground rail); inductors 1 and 2 and capacitors 3 and 4 are vertical and listed top-then-bottom. Order does not affect any metric.
